title: Fresh Coat
description: Roll fresh color across four filthy walls, manage paint coverage, and transform the whole room before the final reveal.

prompt.objective: Build a tactile paint-roller game about covering four grimy walls with fresh color.

mintAssets.brief: A chunky chrome and wool paint roller.
Grimy brick, damp plaster, and graffiti concrete PBR walls.

experience: Paint each wall and cross corners while the camera follows the active surface.
Choose colors, refill, track coverage, and finish with a before-and-after reveal.
prompt.visualDirection: A tactile renovation scene with dirty material detail, saturated paint swatches, soft room lighting, and celebratory confetti.

thumbnail.alt: A paint roller laying a vivid fresh coat across a grimy interior wall.

social.title: Fresh Coat
social.description: Roll vivid paint over four grimy walls and reveal a completely transformed room.

image.alt: A paint roller laying a vivid fresh coat across a grimy interior wall.
